about_the_game:
Life/Death - ARPG in Cartoon setting.

A representative of office plankton accidentally gets into another world through a portal, where his skills lose relevance. He wants to return to his world, but does not know how to do so, as the beings capable of opening portals are not interested in helping him. In the process of driving out help from these "personalities", the hero drags into a global conflict between worlds.

Key Features

Story

You will take on the role of an unknown warrior or leader who can do anything... And feel like one of the many heroes who save worlds, protect kingdom by chance!
To avoid spoiling, we can say that the main hero is the best employee of the month in the office, the best friend of Death, a caring hamster owner and the master of the farm!

Humor and fun

Unlike most ARPG’s, this game is not about epic and drama. You will be immersed in a world of fun, chaos and unexpected plot twists.

Visual Style

Instead of the beaten Dark Fenezie, you will immerse yourself in a mass of colors, as the setting of the world Life Slash Death is bright, animated and filled with a bunch of different pastries, meeting which you will smile repeatedly.

Gameplay

Familiar ARPG is diluted by managing its own location with the ability to remove typical and annoying mechanics such as boring greenery and weak economy. It’s up to you to choose how to create the best equipment to crush your opponents with clouds.
